title: poa minuta
intro: Poa minuta, commonly known as Blue Fescue Grass, is a species of grass that belongs to the Poaceae family. It is a perennial plant with a compact growth habit, typically found in mountainous regions. The health benefits of Poa minuta include its potential use in treating various ailments such as fever, cough, and respiratory issues, due to its expectorant properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, and its therapeutic actions include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects.
